title: chore(deps) bump vulnerable packages
author: Kielek
body:
# Changes

- Updated Go vulnerable dependency pins:
  - `golang.org/x/crypto` to `v0.52.0` in `src/checkout`
  - `golang.org/x/net` to `v0.55.0` in `src/checkout` and `src/product-catalog`
  - `golang.org/x/sys` to `v0.45.0` as required by the Go module solver
- Regenerated touched `go.sum` files from scratch.
- Added a frontend `qs` override to `6.15.2` because `@cypress/request` still requests a vulnerable `qs` range.
- Regenerated `src/frontend/package-lock.json` from scratch.

## Fixed vulnerabilities
